tests.title: The aflib require, replace, Containerfile, Makefile and workflow wiring are present and the module builds
given: a sibling ../aflib checkout
tests.when: go.mod, containers/hub/Containerfile, Makefile and the hub and afc workflow files are read and go build ./... is run
then: go.mod requires github.com/agent-fox-dev/aflib v0.0.0 and replaces it with ../aflib
the Containerfile copies the aflib build context
the build-hub-container target passes --build-context aflib=../aflib
the hub and afc workflows clone aflib next to the repository
go build ./... exits 0
tests.pseudocode: mod = read('go.mod'); assert 'github.com/agent-fox-dev/aflib => ../aflib' in mod; assert 'aflib=../aflib' in read('Makefile'); assert exec('go build ./...').exit == 0

tests.title: Only packages under internal/forge import issuex

then: every package importing github.com/agent-fox-dev/aflib/issuex has an import path under internal/forge
tests.pseudocode: for pkg in go_list('./...'): if 'aflib/issuex' in pkg.Imports: assert pkg.ImportPath.startswith('.../internal/forge')

tests.title: afc does not depend on internal/forge and builds with CGO disabled
given: the hub module
tests.when: go list -deps ./cmd/afc is run and CGO_ENABLED=0 go build ./cmd/afc is run
then: no dependency path contains internal/forge
the build exits 0
tests.pseudocode: deps = exec('go list -deps ./cmd/afc'); assert 'internal/forge' not in deps; assert exec('CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o /tmp/afc ./cmd/afc').exit == 0
